en.headline: Government appoints Li Zili as drug and medical device regulator
en.dek: The Director of Health said the appointment of the experienced specialist will help build Hong Kong's capacity for independent review and approval of drugs and devices.
body: The government announced on Monday that it has completed a global open recruitment and appointed Li Zili as Director of Drug and Medical Device Regulation under the Department of Health. The three-year term begins on 20 October.

Director of Health Dr Lam Man-kin said the new Drug and Medical Device Regulatory Centre will be established within 2026 to promote more proactive first-tier approval, accelerate clinical use of products that meet quality and safety standards, and support Hong Kong's development as an international medical innovation hub. He described Li as an outstanding leader with deep experience in international regulation and public health policy.

Li holds a medical degree from Peking Union Medical College and completed residency training and a Master of Public Health at Johns Hopkins University. He is a licensed physician in the United States with more than 30 years of experience in drug regulation and global drug development. He has served twice at the US Food and Drug Administration, including as a clinical review supervisor and later as global affairs supervisor for generic drugs, and has held senior roles at multinational pharmaceutical companies, including as Global Vice President and Asia-Pacific R&D Head at Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies of Johnson & Johnson.

Li is a fellow and global board member of the Drug Information Association. He received a special contribution award in regulatory science from China's drug evaluation centre in 2013 and a special recognition award from the FDA in 2014. The government said he was also a core participant in China's accession to the International Council for Harmonisation in 2017.

zh.headline: 政府委任李自力為藥械監管總監 任期三年
zh.dek: 衛生署署長指，委任具豐富國際經驗的專才，有助建立本港自主藥械審評審批能力，加快符合品質及安全要求的產品臨床應用。
body: 政府周一宣布，已完成全球公開招聘，委任李自力為衛生署轄下藥物及醫療器械監督管理總監，任期由十月二十日起計，為期三年。
衛生署署長林文健醫生表示，藥械監管中心將於二零二六年內成立，推動更主動的第一層審批，加快符合品質及安全要求的最先進醫療藥械產品臨床應用，並配合本港建設國際醫療創新樞紐。他形容李自力對國際藥械監管及公共衛生政策有深入了解，是具視野和魄力的領導者。
李自力於北京協和醫學院取得醫學學位，在美國約翰霍普金斯大學完成駐院醫師培訓及公共衛生碩士學位。他是美國執業醫師，在藥品監管及全球藥物研發領域擁有逾三十年經驗，曾兩度任職美國食品及藥物管理局，擔任臨床審評主管及仿製藥全球事務主管，亦曾出任強生集團楊森製藥全球副總裁暨亞太區研發主管。
李自力是國際藥物訊息協會會士及全球理事會成員，二零一三年獲中國藥品審評中心頒發法規科學特別貢獻獎，二零一四年獲美國FDA特別表彰。政府指他亦是促成國家於二零一七年加入國際人用藥品註冊技術協調會的核心參與者之一。
